body:
# EndlessPixel | Minecraft 1.21.11 A Whole New World
A pixel realm where infinite possibilities become reality – embark on the genuine Minecraft adventure!

A premium Minecraft community built around **free creation and equal gameplay**, fully supporting offline mode. Both official and third‑party launcher players can join without barriers to explore the wonderful pixel world together.

### Core Advantages
✅ **Offline Access** – No premium verification required; all launchers can connect with one click, anytime, anywhere.

✅ **Vanilla‑Like Experience** – True to vanilla balance, only enhanced with quality‑of‑life plugins to restore pure Minecraft fun.

✅ **100% Free** – No paywalls, no in‑game purchases. All features and gameplay are free for everyone.

✅ **Free Exploration** – Relaxed rules, anti‑cheat and anti‑griefing protection; unleash your creativity and build your world.

✅ **Progression System** – Brand‑new skills + 1000+ custom advancements for meaningful growth and goals.

✅ **Safe & Stable** – Anti‑cheat protection, cloud backups, and 99.9% uptime for a smooth experience.

✅ **Active Community** – Friendly player base, real‑time interaction, group adventures, and collaborative builds.

### Enhanced Featured Gameplay
8 refined core systems that boost convenience, fun, and progression:
- **Custom Skill System** – Mining, combat, survival, and more. Level up through gameplay to unlock passive/active abilities.
- **1000+ New Advancements** – Cover building, exploration, combat, and social activities for constant goals and satisfaction.
- **Sit & Relax** – Right-click slabs or stairs with an empty hand to sit down and enjoy the moment.
- **Vein Miner** – Sneak with the proper tool to mine up to 128 connected blocks at once.
- **Crop Protection** – Crops cannot be trampled, keeping your farms safe from accidental damage.
- **Expanded Exploration** – 300+ new structures, themed villages, mysterious dungeons, and rare ruins to discover.
- **Master Crafting** – Stonecutter expanded with 500+ recipes, including advanced wood and stone carving.
- **Land Claiming** – Create and manage protected lands to secure your builds and items.

### Technical Info
📌 **Client Version**: Minecraft Java 1.21.11 (down to 1.7.2, untested – compatibility not guaranteed)

📌 **Live Updates**: Continuous server improvements with advance notices for restarts.

📌 **18/7 Support**: Long‑term maintenance and content updates with over 800 unique features.

### Join the Adventure Now
👥 **Official QQ Group**: 870594910

👥 **Discord**: https://discord.gg/k63hRWt3fF

Get the latest news, support, meet fellow players, unlock skills and advancements, and team up for endless pixel adventures!
